room_description: A modern, minimalist living room or office featuring a central wooden door, a desk with a laptop to the left, a large potted plant, and a large wooden cabinet to the right. The walls are decorated with simple tree-themed artwork.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot showing the entire room including the sofa, desk, and cabinet.
Zooming in on the potted plant to find a hidden item in the soil.
Revealing the numerical code 1886 on the laptop screen after entering the password.
Opening the wooden box inside the cabinet using a four-digit code.

solution_steps: Zoom into the potted plant to the left of the door
Search the soil at the base of the plant
Use the silver key on the bottom-left door of the wooden cabinet
Interact with the laptop on the desk
Enter the password 'TAKI' as suggested by the paper clue
Locate the wooden box on the shelf inside the opened cabinet
Enter the code 1886 on the keypad

final_action: The player uses the key card on the electronic door handle of the center door to unlock it and exit the room.
